name: biomate
description: BioMate scientific workflow platform — search, run, and monitor bioinformatics workflows via MCP

tools.name: search_workflow
tools.description: Search BioMate workflow catalog by natural language query

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Execute a workflow on AWS Batch and return a run_id

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Poll status of a running workflow execution

tools.name: get_run_results
tools.description: Retrieve output files from a completed run

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query biological databases: UniProt, PDB, NCBI Gene, dbSNP, KEGG, ChEBI, HPO, STRING

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.description: Run lightweight QC analysis on FASTQ, CSV, VCF, FASTA, BAM files

MCP_DEBUG.description: Set to 1 for verbose stderr logging

claude_desktop_config.note: Run from biomate/backend/lib directory, or set PYTHONPATH to include it
